fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature

fields.name: GROUND_TEMP_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature uncertainty (standard deviation)

fields.description: 0 = RSM head obstructing the upward looking channels FoV, 1 = RSM head outside the FoV

fields.name: WHEEL_OUTSIDE_TIRS_DOWNWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description: 0 = Front right wheel obstructing the TIRS downward looking channels FoV, 1 = Rover front right wheel outside the FoV

fields.name: SUN_OUTSIDE_TIRS_FOV
fields.description: 0 = Sun in the TIRS upward looking and UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE channels FoV, 1 = Sun outside the FoV

fields.description: 0 = high tilt (rover tilt greater or equal than +-20 degrees), 1 = low (rover tilt less or equal than +-20 degrees). Rover tilt = (pich2 + roll2)1/2. When low tilt, TIRS channels FoV are completely covered by ground (downward looking) or sky (upward looking)

fields.name: TIRS_GROUND_FOOTPRINT_NOT_IN_SHADOW
fields.description: 0 = Ground focused area is shadowed by the rover, 1 = Ground focused area not shadowed by the rover

fields.name: ROVER_HGA_OFF
fields.description: 0 = Rover HGA Antenna is on, 1 = Antenna is off

fields.name: SKYCAM_OFF
fields.description: 0 = SkyCam is on, 1 = SkyCam is off

fields.name: ROVER_STILL
fields.description: 0 = Rover is moving, 1 = Rover is motionless

fields.name: SCLK
fields.description:
Spacecraft Clock, as approximated by MEDA internal clock,
            at the time of the observation, without partition and
            including decimal thousandths of a second

fields.name: LMST
fields.description: Local Mean Solar Time

fields.name: LTST
fields.description: Local True Solar Time

fields.name: DOWNWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description:
TIRS Downward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) for a hemispherical FOV

fields.name: DOWNWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description:
TIRS Downward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) uncertainty (standard deviation) for a
            hemispherical FOV

fields.name: AIR_TEMP
fields.description: TIRS Air Temperature

fields.name: AIR_TEMP_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Air Temperature uncertainty (standard deviation)

fields.name: UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description: TIRS Upward SW (0.3-3 μm band), for a hemispherical FoV

fields.name: UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Upward SW uncertainty (standard deviation), for a hemispherical FoV

fields.name: UPWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description:
TIRS Upward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) for a hemispherical FOV

fields.name: UPWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description:
TIRS Upward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) uncertainty (standard deviation) for a
            hemispherical FOV

fields.name: GROUND_TEMP
fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature

fields.name: GROUND_TEMP_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature uncertainty (standard deviation)

fields.name: RSM_HEAD_OUTSIDE_TIRS_UPWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description:
0 = RSM head obstructing the upward looking channels FoV,
            1 = RSM head outside the FoV

fields.name: WHEEL_OUTSIDE_TIRS_DOWNWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Front right wheel obstructing the TIRS downward
            looking channels FoV,
            1 = Rover front right wheel outside the FoV

fields.name: SUN_OUTSIDE_TIRS_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Sun in the TIRS upward looking and UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE channels FoV,
            1 = Sun outside the FoV

fields.name: ROVER_LOW_TILT
fields.description:
0 = high tilt (rover tilt greater or equal than +-20 degrees),
            1 = low (rover tilt less or equal than +-20 degrees).
            Rover tilt = (pich2 + roll2)1/2. When low tilt, TIRS
            channels FoV are completely covered by ground
            (downward looking) or sky (upward looking)

fields.name: TIRS_GROUND_FOOTPRINT_NOT_IN_SHADOW
fields.description:
0 = Ground focused area is shadowed by the rover,
            1 = Ground focused area not shadowed by the rover

fields.name: ROVER_HGA_OFF
fields.description:
0 = Rover HGA Antenna is on,
            1 = Antenna is off

fields.name: SKYCAM_OFF
fields.description:
0 = SkyCam is on,
            1 = SkyCam is off

fields.name: ROVER_STILL
fields.description:
0 = Rover is moving,
	    1 = Rover is motionless

title: Mars 2020 MEDA Thermal Infrared Sensor Calibrated Data

fields.name: SCLK
fields.description:
Spacecraft Clock, as approximated by MEDA internal clock,
            at the time of the observation, without partition and
            including decimal thousandths of a second

fields.name: LMST
fields.description: Local Mean Solar Time

fields.name: LTST
fields.description: Local True Solar Time

fields.name: DOWNWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description:
TIRS Downward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) for a hemispherical FOV

fields.name: DOWNWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description:
TIRS Downward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) uncertainty (standard deviation) for a
            hemispherical FOV

fields.name: AIR_TEMP
fields.description: TIRS Air Temperature

fields.name: AIR_TEMP_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Air Temperature uncertainty (standard deviation)

fields.name: UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description: TIRS Upward SW (0.3-3 μm band), for a hemispherical FoV

fields.name: UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Upward SW uncertainty (standard deviation), for a hemispherical FoV

fields.name: UPWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE
fields.description:
TIRS Upward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) for a hemispherical FOV

fields.name: UPWARD_LW_IRRADIANCE_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description:
TIRS Upward LW irradiance inside channel bandpass
            (6.5-30 μm) uncertainty (standard deviation) for a
            hemispherical FOV

fields.name: GROUND_TEMP
fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature

fields.name: GROUND_TEMP_UNCERTAINTY
fields.description: TIRS Ground brightness temperature uncertainty (standard deviation)

fields.name: RSM_HEAD_OUTSIDE_TIRS_UPWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description:
0 = RSM head obstructing the upward looking channels FoV,
            1 = RSM head outside the FoV

fields.name: WHEEL_OUTSIDE_TIRS_DOWNWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Front right wheel obstructing the TIRS downward
            looking channels FoV,
            1 = Rover front right wheel outside the FoV

fields.name: SUN_OUTSIDE_TIRS_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Sun in the TIRS upward looking and UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE channels FoV,
            1 = Sun outside the FoV

fields.name: ROVER_LOW_TILT
fields.description:
0 = high tilt (rover tilt greater or equal than +-20 degrees),
            1 = low (rover tilt less or equal than +-20 degrees).
            Rover tilt = (pich2 + roll2)1/2. When low tilt, TIRS
            channels FoV are completely covered by ground
            (downward looking) or sky (upward looking)

fields.name: TIRS_GROUND_FOOTPRINT_NOT_IN_SHADOW
fields.description:
0 = Ground focused area is shadowed by the rover,
            1 = Ground focused area not shadowed by the rover

fields.name: ROVER_HGA_OFF
fields.description:
0 = Rover HGA Antenna is on,
            1 = Antenna is off

fields.name: SKYCAM_OFF
fields.description:
0 = SkyCam is on,
            1 = SkyCam is off

fields.name: ROVER_STILL
fields.description:
0 = Rover is moving,
	    1 = Rover is motionless

            1 = RSM head outside the FoV

fields.name: WHEEL_OUTSIDE_TIRS_DOWNWARD_LOOKING_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Front right wheel obstructing the TIRS downward
            looking channels FoV,
            1 = Rover front right wheel outside the FoV

fields.name: SUN_OUTSIDE_TIRS_FOV
fields.description:
0 = Sun in the TIRS upward looking and UPWARD_SW_IRRADIANCE channels FoV,
            1 = Sun outside the FoV

fields.name: ROVER_LOW_TILT
fields.description:
0 = high tilt (rover tilt greater or equal than +-20 degrees),
            1 = low (rover tilt less or equal than +-20 degrees).
            Rover tilt = (pich2 + roll2)1/2. When low tilt, TIRS
            channels FoV are completely covered by ground
            (downward looking) or sky (upward looking)

fields.name: TIRS_GROUND_FOOTPRINT_NOT_IN_SHADOW
fields.description:
0 = Ground focused area is shadowed by the rover,
            1 = Ground focused area not shadowed by the rover

fields.name: ROVER_HGA_OFF
fields.description:
0 = Rover HGA Antenna is on,
            1 = Antenna is off

fields.name: SKYCAM_OFF
fields.description:
0 = SkyCam is on,
            1 = SkyCam is off

fields.name: ROVER_STILL
fields.description:
0 = Rover is moving,
	    1 = Rover is motionless
